name: Morning wake-up
description: 5-minute easy sequence to wake the body up.

poses.name: Mountain pose
poses.notes: Stand tall, feet hip-width, arms by your sides. Breathe deep into the belly.

poses.name: Standing forward fold
poses.notes: Hinge at the hips, soft knees, let the head hang. Sway gently if it feels good.

poses.name: Cat-cow on the floor
poses.notes: Hands and knees. Inhale: belly drops, gaze up. Exhale: round the spine, chin to chest.

poses.name: Downward-facing dog
poses.notes: Press the floor away. Bend the knees if hamstrings need it. Pedal the feet.

poses.name: Low lunge, right
poses.notes: Right foot forward, left knee down. Sink the hips. Lift the chest.

poses.name: Low lunge, left
poses.notes: Mirror it. Left foot forward, right knee down.

poses.name: Seated forward fold
poses.notes: Legs long, fold from the hips, not the waist. Let the head hang heavy.
